judgment.aVerdict: projection did NOT drop: +5,186 tokens while the durable ledger shadowed 5,638 (rq3-f1 reproduced under autoNudge)

bNudgePressureSource.answer: the host contextPressure projection path (rule-2 chain: sessionProjections.contextPressure.projectedTokens preferred)
evidence: pre-compression nudge (seq 417) read 78% -> basis 25,559 tokens; host projection at that point was 25,510 (delta 49)
arc_status estimated context 29,939/32,768 (91%) tracks the projection scale, not surface-minus-shadowed
post-compression readings kept RISING (86%->94%) with the projection instead of dropping by the 5,638 shadowed tokens

judgment.cClassification: nudge-overpressure product defect (evidence complete; fix deferred to a separate commission - no src/ changes in this one)
judgment.cReasoning: conservative compression-aware counterfactual (reading basis - ledger shadowed; ignores the summary text that also re-enters, so the true correction is larger): the 86% emergency nudge falls to 68.8% (below the 70% forced line - no nudge at all) and the 90-94% emergency nudges fall to 72.8-76.8% (normal tier). All six post-compression emergency firings are artifacts of the non-subtracting projection. Aggravating: ARC nudges are DURABLE user messages (source.plugin arc-nudge), so each artifact nudge permanently adds transcript noise - six of them accumulated on the surface in this session alone.
judgment.rule2Wording: AGENTS rule 2 (and the resolveTokenCount docstring "Provider-anchored; reacts to compaction") is falsified for this host surface: the preferred projection does NOT react to compaction. Wording should state that the preferred source is host-projection-anchored but NOT compression-aware, and that ARC-side subtraction of the ledger shadowed total is required for post-compression pressure.
scopeNotes: window 32,768 with ~13.5K fixed overhead (web Standard preset: system prompt + tools + runtime snapshot + skill catalog) leaves little room below the 70% line; the counterfactual is computed on the reading basis, not the real prompt, because the real prompt was itself inflated by the accumulated artifact nudges
autoNudge was OFF in RQ2/RQ3, so this path was never exercised there; the RQ3 smoke observation (projection rising after compression) is the same mechanism seen from the outside
